pp.meta.title: AI Pipe Planner | AL-KOBLAN
pp.meta.description: Plan a preliminary water-pipe network for your home or project with photos, measurements and AL-KOBLAN products.
pp.title: AI Pipe Planner
pp.intro: Describe your project, upload photos and measurements, and get a preliminary pipe layout and bill of materials matched to the AL-KOBLAN catalog.
pp.disclaimer.title: Preliminary estimate only.
pp.disclaimer.body: Results are AI-assisted and conceptual. They are not a construction-ready design and cannot confirm hidden pipes, pressures or pipe sizes. A qualified plumber or engineer must verify everything before installation.
pp.unavailable: The AI analysis is temporarily unavailable. You can still prepare your project, or contact our sales team.
pp.details.notes_ph: Anything that helps us understand the project
pp.photos.tip_walls: The walls where pipes will run, from a few steps back.
pp.photos.tip_supply: The main water connection point and any meter or tank.
pp.photos.tip_fixtures: Each fixture location: sinks, toilets, showers, heaters.
pp.photos.tip_pipes: Any visible existing pipes and connections.
pp.photos.tip_access: Accessible installation areas such as ceilings or shafts.
pp.photos.tip_scale: Where practical, include an open tape measure or ruler in the shot.
pp.photos.scale_body: Ordinary photos cannot give reliable dimensions. Lengths are only considered from photos where you mark a visible scale reference, and you should still enter measured distances in the next step.
pp.photos.privacy_body: Avoid people, documents, screens or addresses in photos. Photos are stored privately, location metadata is removed where possible, and you can delete them at any time.
pp.photos.drop: Drag and drop photos here, or
pp.photos.limits: Up to :max photos · JPG, PNG or WEBP · max :size MB each
pp.photos.empty: No photos yet. At least one photo is needed for the analysis.
pp.photos.too_large_server: The file is larger than the server allows.
pp.photos.bad_type: :name is not a supported image (JPG, PNG or WEBP).
pp.photos.too_many: You can upload up to :max photos.
pp.photos.caption: What does this photo show?
pp.photos.caption_ph: e.g. kitchen wall, sink on the left
pp.photos.has_scale: Contains a tape measure / known-size reference
pp.measure.intro: Enter what you know. Use "I don't know" for anything you have not measured — the analysis will flag what is missing instead of guessing.
pp.measure.distances: Distances between supply points and fixtures
pp.measure.distances_help: Example: from "main valve" to "kitchen sink", 4.5 m. Measured distances are used directly in quantity calculations.
pp.analyze.intro: Your photos, measurements and the relevant AL-KOBLAN catalog data will be analyzed securely on our server. This usually takes under two minutes.
pp.analyze.need_photo: Add at least one photo before starting the analysis.
pp.analyze.wait: You can keep this page open; your project is saved.
pp.analyze.reused: Nothing changed since the last analysis, so the existing result is shown.
pp.analyze.retry_hint: You can try again, or contact our sales team.
pp.analyze.slow: The analysis is taking longer than expected. Your project is saved — reopen it later from "My saved projects".
pp.failure.not_configured: The AI planner is not configured yet.
pp.failure.provider_unavailable: The AI service is unreachable right now.
pp.failure.model_unavailable: The configured AI model is unavailable.
pp.failure.model_not_vision: The configured AI model cannot read images.
pp.failure.timeout: The AI service did not respond in time.
pp.failure.insufficient_credits: The AI service is temporarily unavailable.
pp.failure.auth_failed: The AI service is temporarily unavailable.
pp.failure.provider_error: The AI service returned an error.
pp.failure.bad_request: The AI service could not process this project (photos may be unsupported).
pp.failure.malformed_response: The AI service returned an unreadable answer.
pp.failure.empty_response: The AI service returned an empty answer.
pp.failure.invalid_output: The AI answer did not pass our safety and format checks, so it was not shown.
pp.failure.internal_error: Something went wrong during the analysis.
pp.failure.job_failed: The analysis could not be completed.
pp.results.layout_note: Conceptual schematic only — not to scale and not a construction drawing. Dashed lines are proposed or unverified.
pp.results.waste_applied: A :p% allowance is applied to pipe lengths only.
pp.results.waste_none: No waste allowance applied. Quantities are net lengths.
pp.results.questions_note: Answering these improves the plan. Your answers are saved and a new analysis version is created.
pp.results.no_observations: No objects could be identified from the photos.
pp.results.no_items: No components can be listed yet. Please answer the questions or add measurements.
pp.next.saved_account: Project :ref is saved to your account.
pp.next.saved_guest: Project :ref is saved in this browser session. Log in to keep it in your account.
pp.quote.title: F. Request a quotation
pp.quote.already: A quotation request was already sent for this report version. Our sales team will contact you.
pp.quote.intro: Review the items and quantities, then send them to our sales team. This is a request only — no order is placed and nothing is charged. Prices are confirmed by AL-KOBLAN in the final quotation.
pp.quote.name: Full name
pp.quote.approve_assumptions: I have reviewed the assumptions and understand quantities are preliminary.
pp.quote.confirm: Send this preliminary list to AL-KOBLAN as a quotation request.
pp.quote.sent: Your request was sent (reference :ref). Our sales team will contact you with a quotation.
pp.bom.unknown_segments: :n segment(s) without a length are not included
pp.bom.legend: Pipe quantities are calculated by our system from segment lengths; fitting counts are preliminary AI estimates from the proposed route. Sizes are proposals that require professional verification.
pp.layout.insufficient: There is not enough evidence for a reliable layout yet. Review the observations and answer the outstanding questions, then re-run the analysis.
pp.validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.
pp.error.network: Connection problem. Please check your internet and try again.
pp.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
pp.report.title: Preliminary pipe planning report
